title: Verification-only command contract declaration (positive fixture)
description: Positive fixture: a conforming command contract declaration that declares capability in exactly one category — verification checks (two structural checks in the contract categories). The lifecycle-phases, config-extensions, and templates categories declare nothing; the activation sequence is exactly prepare, configure, verify, promote — the runtime proceeds with its generic operations at the framework-phases position. The verification exchange declares its rules at the fixed 'verify' position; the full exchange rule set C1–C7 plus the declared-surface bound is affirmed.
